description: Source code for analyzing whether a kernel preserves zero masks in PyTorch's TorchInductor compiler, including classes and functions for handling dtype propagation, low precision operations, and code generation analysis.

classes.name: PreservesZeros
classes.description: Handles detection of whether a kernel's load and store operations preserve zeros, used in prologue kernels.

classes.name: DTypeContainer
classes.description: Container for dtype and scalar flag, used in low precision operation tracking.

classes.name: RecordLowPrecisionOps
classes.description: Tracks low precision operations within a kernel to determine if code can be generated without upcasting.

methods.name: construct_symbol
methods.description: Creates a sympy Symbol with a unique name based on a counter.

methods.name: prologue_preserves_zero_mask
methods.description: Determines if a given prologue kernel preserves zero masks.

methods.name: can_codegen_without_upcasts
methods.description: Checks if a kernel can be generated without upcasting to FP32/FP64 while preserving numeric correctness.
